caveat: This is a partial control mapping, not an audit. security-mcp maps gate findings to a subset of controls for SOC 2, PCI DSS 4.0, NIST 800-53, and ISO 27001; it does not collect the full evidence an auditor requires. 'satisfied' means the gate ran and found no adverse finding for a control whose workflow steps completed — not that the control is certified.

controls.description: Secrets stored only in a dedicated secret manager.
evidence: No adverse finding in the completed gate run.

controls.description: Self-healing changes only happen after explicit human approval.
evidence: Required workflow step(s) not completed: self_heal_loop

controls.description: Audit events are logged, immutable, timestamped, and retained ≥1 year (NIST 800-53 AU).
evidence: No adverse finding in the completed gate run.

controls.description: Incident response playbooks exist, are tested, and have defined MTTD/MTTR SLAs (NIST 800-53 IR).
evidence: No adverse finding in the completed gate run.

controls.description: Logical access to systems is restricted and uses MFA for privileged accounts (SOC 2 CC6).
evidence: No adverse finding in the completed gate run.

controls.description: System components are monitored for anomalous activity and security events (SOC 2 CC7).
evidence: No adverse finding in the completed gate run.

controls.description: Changes are authorized, tested, and reviewed before deployment (SOC 2 CC8).
evidence: Verified: no adverse finding; completed steps: run_pr_gate

controls.description: Security risks are identified and formally risk-accepted or remediated (SOC 2 CC9).
evidence: Verified: no adverse finding; completed steps: threat_model, run_pr_gate

controls.description: Incident response playbooks exist for all surfaces, are tested within 90 days, and have contact lists.
evidence: No adverse finding in the completed gate run.
